up: List all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4340561. For each such molecule, retrieve its ChEMBL ID, preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (if available). Order the results by the molecule's ChEMBL ID in ascending order. If a molecule lacks SMILES, still include it with NULL in that column. Ensure each molecule appears only once (use DISTINCT).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    md.max_phase,
    md.molecule_type,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM compound_records cr
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4340561'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
